meta.name: Monty Python's Flying Circus
meta.description:
A British sketch comedy series with the shows being composed of surreality, risqué or innuendo-laden humour, sight gags and observational sketches without punchlines.

Not complete. On your server: S1 1/13 (missing E2-13) | S2 2/13 (missing E1, E3-12) | S3 1/13 (missing E1-2, E4-13) | S4 1/6 (missing E1-3, E5-6)

videos.title: Whither Canada?
videos.overview: Featuring 'It's Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart', an Italian lesson, Whizzo Butter, 'It's the Arts', Arthur 'Two-Sheds' Jackson, a cycling race, and The Funniest Joke in the World.

videos.title: The Spanish Inquisition
videos.overview: Featuring the Spanish Inquisition, courtroom charades and a semaphore interpretation of Wuthering Heights.

videos.title: Royal Episode 13
videos.overview: Sketches in this episode include How to Feed a Goldfish, The Man Who Says Things in a Very Roundabout Way and Lifeboat.

videos.title: The Money Programme
videos.overview: Features The Money Programme, Erizabeth L, Dead Bishop, Jungle Restaurant and The Argument Skit.

videos.title: Hamlet
videos.overview: Sketches in this episode include Hamlet and Ophelia, Bogus Psychiatrists, Police Helmets, Boxing Match Aftermath and The Queen Victoria Handicap.

meta.slogan: And now for something completely different...
